newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Gilts to consolidate back towards 113-00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Gilts to consolidate back towards 113-00.

text.p: September gilt futures will slip down towards the 113-00 area on Tuesday gathering forces for a rally later in the week, technical analysts said.

"Gilts will be relatively quiet and the drift lower will continue today, but over the next several days the market can retest the highs and go higher," said Neil Irving, technical analyst at 4CAST in London.
Irving said initial support was in the 113-08 to 113-10 area, reflecting intra-day congestion and Friday's low.
"But it is possible that the market could go all the way down to 113-00 before it stabilises," he said.
That level was the low on June 4 and offers psychological support.
September gilt futures traded on LIFFE opened at 113-18, up 1/32 from Monday's close, and were trading at 113-13 by 0721 GMT.
Lynn Branigan, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London, said this breached a minor support level for gilts.
"Sustained losses through here will target 113-00," he said. "And further losses through there will be looking at 112-05."
This would take the contract back to the base area from which it has rallied in the last three weeks, Branigan said.
"Really to put a hold on the weakness we need to turn back over 113-20," he said.
Irving said for now the upside would be capped around 113-24 to 113-27, which encompasses daily highs from the early part of last week.
But Branigan said if the contract did move higher, more resistance was offered at recent highs in the 114-06, 08 area.
"And a breach of resistance there would target further gains towards the contract high," he said.
At the short end, September short sterling futures were at 93.07, down two basis points on the day.
